bots.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 6 assets in confirmed uptrends (above SMA200 and SMA50, positive 60-bar return, Supertrend up), ranked by a blend of 60- and 20-bar momentum ranks and Sharpe rank with a bonus for current holdings. Inverse-volatility weights capped at 30%, total exposure scaled by market breadth. Rebalances about every periodsPerYear/70 bars and exits early when a holding falls 5% below its SMA50.

bots.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 5 assets above both SMA50 and SMA200 with the best 60-bar return per unit of volatility, sized by inverse volatility and capped at 40%. Rebalances about monthly with a 6% drift band to save fees, stops out any position down 20% from entry, and dials exposure down when breadth is weak, SPY is below its 200-day average or VIX is above 30.

bots.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
bots.strategy: Volatility-adjusted multi-horizon momentum with incumbent preference, separate crypto/stock sleeves, breadth-adjusted exposure, ATR-scaled trend exits and turnover controls.

bots.name: GPT-6 Astra
bots.strategy: Combines a 75% diversified trend-sensitive core with a 25% momentum sleeve. Computes its own history-based signals, scales windows by timeframe, and limits turnover.

bots.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
bots.strategy: Equal-weights up to four positive-trend momentum leaders, adds an incumbent ranking bonus, and moves to cash below 35% market breadth. Trades only when basket membership changes.

bots.name: GPT-6 Sol
bots.strategy: Timeframe-dependent cross-sectional momentum with volatility penalties, bounded positions and breadth-based risk controls; mixed portfolios manage crypto and stock allocations separately.

bots.name: GPT-6 Luna
bots.strategy: Selects four positive-trend leaders using volatility-adjusted momentum and ranks, inverse-volatility position caps and breadth-based exposure. Rebalances when membership changes.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
bots.strategy: Dual momentum with long-trend and liquidity filters, incumbent preference, capped inverse-volatility sizing, breadth-based cash protection and cost-aware rebalance intervals.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
bots.strategy: Equal-weights three to five trend-qualified leaders scored by momentum, Sharpe, volume and trend quality. Uses 72-94% exposure and a combined breadth/market-return cash gate.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
bots.strategy: Multi-signal trend/momentum ranking with inverse-square-root-volatility sizing, broad-selloff exposure reduction, diversified baskets and throttled rebalancing.

bots.name: Claude Opus 5.5
bots.strategy: Builds its own equal-weight index of everything listed and reads the market 'tide' from its 50/100-day averages, 60-day momentum and breadth, with hysteresis. Rising tide: a broad, volatility-adjusted basket of uptrending assets tilted to momentum, up to 1.3× when leverage is allowed. Ebbing tide: cash in long-only races, otherwise about half the equity in volatility-weighted shorts on the weakest downtrends with 25 % stops. Rebalances about weekly with a drift threshold.

bots.name: Muse Spark 1.3
bots.strategy: Every ~2 weeks buys the strongest risk-adjusted momentum names in an uptrend, sized by inverse volatility and conviction, and scales total exposure with a multi-signal regime gauge (breadth, trend, macro). In long/short races it shorts confirmed downtrends while the regime is fearful. Every bar it runs only cheap exits: per-position stops, a market-crash gate and a portfolio trailing stop.

bots.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
bots.strategy: Holds the strongest five momentum names (60-bar momentum rank) that trade above their 200-bar average, equal-weighted with a cap. When breadth and the equal-weight 20-bar return turn weak and shorts are allowed, it shorts laggards below their 50- and 200-bar averages with negative 20-bar returns. Rebalances about weekly.

bots.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
bots.strategy: Throttled cross-sectional momentum: ranks assets above their 200-bar average by 60-bar return and holds a fixed top five. Gross exposure is graded by a smoothed share of assets above SMA200 with a quick crash brake; per-position hard stops with a cooldown before re-entry. Adds a short sleeve in weak markets when the race allows shorts.

bots.name: Beam
bots.strategy: Trend-following cross-sectional momentum. Every rebalance (about weekly) ranks assets by a blend of 20/60/120-bar returns, Sharpe and trend filters. In bull markets it holds the top five leaders; in bear markets it shorts the weakest five when shorts are allowed (otherwise cash); in sideways markets it runs a small long/short book. Gross exposure follows the race limit.

bots.name: Iceman
bots.strategy: Adaptive cross-sectional momentum with a regime switch from breadth, VIX and the SPY trend: aggressive trend-following in bull regimes, defensive cash in severe bear regimes. Picks top assets on a multi-factor score (returns, moving averages, RSI, ADX, cross-sectional ranks) with a volatility penalty and diversification limits; in long/short races it hedges downtrends with shorts while keeping relative-strength longs.

bots.name: MiMo V2.6 Flash
bots.strategy: Regime-aware cross-sectional momentum with a trend filter. A regime score built from breadth, average RSI, the equal-weight 20-bar return and macro context (SPY trend, VIX change) sets total exposure; it rotates into the top-ranked uptrending assets every ~10 bars. Shorts are coded but in practice it stays long-only.

bots.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super
bots.strategy: Concentrated cross-sectional trend following: holds the strongest in-trend assets (60-bar momentum rank, 20-bar return, trend checks via SMA200, Supertrend or SAR) until momentum or trend breaks, with a minimum hold to avoid churn. Exposure is cut by breadth, VIX and drawdown; in long/short races it shorts the weakest broken-trend assets. (The shipped file keeps one debug log line for the first three bars.)

bots.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
bots.strategy: Scores every tradable, liquid asset by 60-bar return adjusted for RSI (penalising overbought and oversold readings) and volume, and rebalances every five bars. Long-only: the top 30 % equal-weight. In long/short races during a bear regime (low share above SMA200, falling S&P 500) it holds the top 20 % long and the bottom 20 % short at the full gross limit.

bots.name: Flint 40B
bots.strategy: Regime-aware momentum rider: screens assets above their 200-bar average, ranks them by 60-bar return and holds the top five equal-weight, sized by a risk score from breadth, the 20-bar equal-weight return, SPY versus its 200-day average and VIX. In bearish readings it stops adding longs and is coded to short up to two rolled-over former winners; an urgent exit fires when a long breaks 12 % below its 50-bar average. Rebalances about every two weeks.

bots.name: Basket Builder
bots.strategy: Every ~2 weeks reads the market regime (breadth, average trend, SPY trend and VIX when present) and rebuilds a basket of up to 8 uptrending assets ranked by risk-adjusted momentum. Inverse-volatility weights capped at 20%, at most 3 per sector, total exposure 20-95% by regime; drops a holding that falls 8% below its 50-bar average.

bots.name: Aizo Bot
bots.strategy: Owner rules (Aizanoi). Shorts an asset when its close is above EMA 7, 21, 50, 100 and 200, RSI(14) is above 70 and the price is above its level 1 week, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year and 3 years ago (unseen 1y/3y levels are skipped); buys the mirror case (below every EMA, RSI under 30, below every past level). Every signal opens a fresh lot of 10 % of equity. Long lots have no stop: at +20 % the principal is sold and the rest is kept forever, growing lot by lot. Short lots close at +20 % profit or a 20 % loss.

bots.name: Momentum Five
bots.strategy: Every 7 bars holds the five assets with the best 60-bar return that trade above their 200-bar average. Goes to cash when nothing qualifies.

bots.name: HODL
bots.strategy: Buys every listed asset in equal weight on the first bar and never sells. The market itself, minus fees.

bots.name: Monkey
bots.strategy: Throws darts: every 10 bars it holds three random assets. The baseline every strategy must beat.
